method: Direct visual inspection of the actual generated screenshots with view_image. This is separate from the automatic blank-frame heuristic.
scope: Selected menu, expanded Phone panel, all three track scenes, and narrow landscape touch layout; not a claim of physical-device validation or review of every captured frame.
result: Selected images have readable, unclipped controls/HUD, nonblank 3D scenes, distinct course environments, and no apparent UI overlap blocking essential controls. Browser Phone panel correctly shows native-app instructions rather than a live TV QR.
